description: Search the sticker library by name or tag (arrow, heart, sparkle, speech, price...). Every word must match. Each result has a media_id: use media:<media_id> as the picture in image_add to lay the sticker over a video. All stickers are transparent PNGs.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

pack.description: Only this pack, by name (see sticker_packs_list)

query.description: Words to find in the name or tags; leave out for everything

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: sticker_search
title: Find stickers
